task.title: [M6] Optional bounded FFprobe/FFmpeg candidate-frame import
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M6
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M6-01
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS; acceptance synchronized after review.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex, verified account aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn; independent forge_qa_reviewer context /root/rsf24_qa.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§4.1–4.2, 6/M6, 8
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Stage local video safely as candidate imagery rather than authoritative animation.

**Scope:** Optional subprocess adapter, source metadata/hash, pinned decode settings, display-order frames and staging.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Capture source SHA-256, FFprobe stream metadata/fps/VFR information, decoder version/settings and display-order decoded frame identities/PTS.
- [x] FFmpeg/FFprobe remain optional adapters; core and image workflow function without them.
- [x] Invoke explicit argument arrays without shell interpolation or project commands; enforce time/resource/decode budgets and isolated path-safe staging.
- [x] Same video and pinned settings yield identical staged frames/hashes; malformed/untrusted videos fail without modifying sources.

## Verification

Synthetic supplied CFR/VFR and malformed media tests, repeated import equality and timeout/path/argument-safety checks; record actual decoder environment.

Actual commands, environment, exit statuses, hashes and NOT_RUN boundaries are recorded in docs/verification/rsf-28/VERIFICATION.md, commands.json and QA_REPORT.md. No artistic approval or new native run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-26 (M5-04; task ID tju1c32n1jrxitklr5hnj6la)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No automatic selection, pose completion or video generation. Reuse validated M4–M5 pipeline; native gate remains separate.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Optional adapters/video.py and _media_exec.py; service/media.py; CLI; closed video/project schemas; focused tests/schema checker; narrow accepted synthetic artifact-guard correction. Exact paths/hashes: docs/verification/rsf-28/implementation-manifest.json.
- Tests: focused 26 PASS; public 478 PASS; private 40 PASS plus one existing skip; all 11 schemas PASS; installed distribution 468 PASS plus ten optional skips; all exit 0. Independent reviewer reran all plus clean extraction and separate RGBA/audio-first cases. Python 3.14.4; 3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN unavailable. FFmpeg/FFprobe 8.0.1-3ubuntu2.
- Gates: accepted M5-S/I/bounded-N scope preserved; no new native execution required. M6 remains open. CLI/API only; no browser control changes. Candidates UNVERIFIED, no automatic assignments/review decisions.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS from separate repository-configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf24_qa. Reviewer independently verified all four criteria, real CFR/VFR/B-frame/multistream extraction, subprocess limits/cleanup, failure publication, immutable staging, all regressions and hashes. Reviewed implementation seal 0f48666f07fa98ea39f5f58810d54cc5631cdf2b57e8b2be7742573aef4e91a5; no mandatory defect remains. Detailed verdict: docs/verification/rsf-28/QA_REPORT.md. Operator artistic authority remains exclusive.
